## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue if applicable.

## Validation

List the checks you actually ran and any checks you could not run.

- [ ] Regression test added or updated for behavior changes
- [ ] SQLite and PostgreSQL compatibility checked for backend changes
- [ ] English, French, Spanish and German translations updated for user-facing text
- [ ] Documentation and migration/upgrade notes updated where needed
- [ ] No secrets, real email addresses, private access links or database dumps included
